items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: And I played, I played cello on that orchestra. Piro and all the musicians, Gaspar, and all of them, Charlie McCurdy, Bloom, and all of them. We played on that occasion.

ctx.x: Oh, I was gonna ask a little bit more about the French Opera. If you can tell us some more about-

Well, as I was saying, we played, uh, Rubichaud played for the Els de Rondre on that yacht. I forget just what year it was. But it was, uh, either one or two years, or three possibly, before the opera boy. And, uh, Rubichaud got an orchestra, he drew upon all the good musicians that he could. And he had an orchestra of 30 pieces, 30 or 36 pieces, something of that sort. And I played, I played cello on that orchestra.
